verificationGuide.title: How to Verify a Real Estate Agent in Kenya

steps.title: Visit the EARB Website
steps.description: Go to the Estate Agents Registration Board website at earb.go.ke

steps.title: Check the Register
steps.description: Use the 'Registered Agents' section to search for the agent or firm by name or registration number

steps.title: Verify License Status
steps.description: Confirm the agent's license is current (renewed annually). Expired licenses mean the agent is not authorized to practice.

steps.title: Report Unregistered Agents
steps.description: If an agent is not in the register, report them to EARB. Operating as an estate agent without registration is an offence under the Estate Agents Act (Cap 533).

earbInfo.name: Estate Agents Registration Board
earbInfo.address: NHIF Building, Wing B, 5th Floor, Ragati Road, Upper Hill, Nairobi

registration: Must be a citizen of Kenya or a company incorporated in Kenya
Must hold a recognized qualification in estate agency, valuation, or related field
Must have at least 2 years of practical experience
Must pay registration and annual renewal fees
Must maintain a fidelity guarantee insurance bond

fees.fidelityBond: Varies by insurer — typically KES 500,000 minimum

redFlags.risk: Illegal to operate without registration — you have no legal recourse if defrauded
Legitimate transactions should have paper trails and receipts

redFlags.flag: Agent refuses to show their EARB certificate
redFlags.risk: All registered agents must display their certificate

redFlags.flag: Property price is significantly below market value
redFlags.risk: May be a scam or the seller doesn't have clear title

redFlags.flag: Agent pushes for immediate full payment
redFlags.risk: Legitimate sales processes involve lawyers, due diligence, and staged payments
All property transactions should have written documentation

notes: The Estate Agents Registration Board (EARB) regulates estate agents in Kenya under the Estate Agents Act (Cap 533)
It is illegal to act as an estate agent without EARB registration — Section 4 of the Act
Registered agents must renew their license annually by March 31
Always insist on seeing an agent's EARB registration certificate before engaging their services
EARB handles complaints against registered agents — you can file via their website or in person
The sample agents list is not exhaustive — always verify directly with EARB
